generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

The bidder is required to ensure browser compatibility of the computer well in advance to the last date and time for receipt of tenders. The departments shall not be responsible for non-accessibility of KPPP portal due to internet connectivity issues and technical glitches at bidders end.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Bidder shall pay Contract Management Module processing fees of 0.025% of the contact value (Min Rs.500/- & Max Rs.7500/-) soon after contract has been issued to bidder.
Conditional tender will not be considered
Tender application amount will not be refundable.
The employer reserves the right to accept any tender and to reject any or all tenders without assigning any reason.
The contractor has to compete the bid (quote the rates Excluding GST) for all schedule B items of the works mentioned.

The Contractor shall pay the Earnest Money Deposit EMD & Tender Transaction fee in the KPPP portal using any of the payment modes like Credit Card, Direct Debit, National Electronic Fund Transfer NEFT, Over the Counter OTC, e-bank guarantee

The tenderer shall scan and upload all the original documents required for this bid to the KPPP portal. The original documents shall be produced at the time of physical verification otherwise the tenders will be treated as Non- responsive& liable for rejection
One percent of the bill amount of the successful tenderer will be deducted towards cess as a labour welfare fund
The contractor has to make his own arrangement for procurement of all materials required for the work. There is no departmental supply of materials.

All documents enclosed should be attested by Gazetted officer or Government Notary, otherwise the bids are liable for disqualification. Original documents should be produced for verification at any stage of the Tender process, as and when sought for. Failure to produce original documents will lead to disqualification. work done certificates should have all the CR no, work order issuing date, work completion date and year and it should be signed not below the rank of Executive Engineer
The tenderer shall have valid Class III & Above Registration Certificate
Omission and typographical errors which are in the opinion of the executive Engineer will not be a ground for claims of extra payment
Royalty charges will be applicable as per prevailing G.O at the time of payment
The tenders are invited as per Standard tender Bid Document KW-3 and shall abide for the conditions contained in Standard tender Bid Document KW-3.
Price adjustment clause will not be applicable as per prevailing government order and only star rates for cement and steel given as per the prevailing G.O No: PWD/159 CRM dt 30.9.2010
The Bidder shall quote Rates WITHOUT adding GST.

Executive engineer reserves the right to accept or reject any tender and to cancel the tender process and reject all tenders at any time prior to award of contract, without there by incurring any liability to the affected tenderer or tenderers or any obligation to inform the affected tenderer or tenderers of the grounds for the employers action
IT & GST will be deducted as per prevailing government order

Contractors have to upload the Certificates of works in hand of any Department/Institutions failing which the tender will not be considered. Action will be taken as per clause26 of SECTION 2: INSTRUCTIONS TO TENDERERS (ITT) in case of incomplete/ false documents regarding works in hand for the calculation of tender capacity
Restrictions on Public Procurement from Bidders of certain countries as per Government order No.FD 455 Exp-12 2020 Bengaluru dated:01-04-2023

The contractor should obtain the Material Dispatch Permit for stone, aggregates, sand and murrum etc will be used in the construction work from the Mines and Geology department at the time of execution and same should be submitted along with the work bill, then for such work bills no Royalty will be deducted. If the contractor failed to submit the Material Dispatch Permit along with the work bill Five times Royalty will be deducted from the work bill as per KMMCR 2016 amendment rule 44(4) and the circular vide No.Ga.Bhu.E/DCB/DCB/Takte/2019-20/4497 Dated : 12/12/2019 by Mines and Geology department
Tenderers shall provide the requested information accurately as per Bid Document
All documents to be furnished are to be counter signed by the employer in charge, not below the rank of an executive in-charge or equivalent.
Annual turnover certificate along with Balance sheet certified/attested by Charted Accountants should be uploaded with 18- Digits system generated unique number (UDIN Number)

Liquid assets and/ or availability of credit facilities from banks for meeting the fund requirement should be submitted in the prescribed format as per the state government circular No. GO-FD-CAM/16/2022 (P-2)/, Banglore Dtd 22-08-2022.
Tenderers shall provide the requested information accurately and in sufficient detail in Section 3
The Defects Liability Period is 365 Days after the completion of work.
The rates of concrete items are inclusive for formwork, shuttering, scaffolding and centering works.
